key.name: appgrid-max-rows
key.description: Number of rows for the applications grid.

key.name: appgrid-max-columns
key.description: Number of columns for the applications grid.

key.name: appgrid-icon-size
key.description: Icon size for app grid icons.

key.name: side-padding
key.description: Horizontal side padding inside the app grid. Can be negative to override system padding.

key.name: label-style
key.description: CSS style string applied to the app icon label.

key.name: label-color
key.description: Label color for the app grid icons. Can be a custom hex code or a legacy style class name. Leave empty to use the system default label color.

key.name: label-shadow-color
key.description: Shadow color for app grid labels when a shadow label style is selected.

key.name: open-animation-time
key.description: Animation time in milliseconds for opening overview side controls.

key.name: page-switch-animation-time
key.description: Animation time in milliseconds when switching pages.

key.name: folder-max-rows
key.description: Number of rows for a folder popup grid.

key.name: folder-max-columns
key.description: Number of columns for a folder popup grid.

key.name: folder-icon-size
key.description: Icon size for app icons inside a folder.

key.name: hide-folder-title
key.description: Hide the folder name/title entry in the folder popup.

key.name: folder-popup-width
key.description: Minimum width in pixels for folder popup dialog.

key.name: folder-popup-height-offset
key.description: Additional height offset for folder popup dialog.

key.name: folder-item-spacing
key.description: Horizontal spacing between items in folder popup.

key.name: folder-item-height-offset
key.description: Extra height added to each item row inside the folder popup in pixels.

key.name: folder-icon-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for app labels inside folders. 0 uses the system default.

key.name: app-icon-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for app labels. 0 uses the system default.

key.name: app-hover-tile-enabled
key.summary: Enable hover tile for app icons (theme-dependent)
key.description: When enabled, app icons in the app grid get a highlighted tile background on hover. The exact appearance can depend on your GNOME Shell theme and version.

key.name: app-hover-tile-background-color
key.description: Background color for the app icon tile on hover. Empty uses a subtle default.

key.name: app-hover-tile-background-opacity
key.description: Opacity for the app hover tile background color (0.0 = fully transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque).

key.name: app-hover-tile-border-color
key.description: Border color for the app icon tile on hover. Empty uses a subtle default.

key.name: app-hover-tile-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels for the app icon tile on hover. 0 uses the theme default.

key.name: folder-popup-background-color
key.description: Background color for the folder popup dialog. Empty uses the theme default.

key.name: folder-popup-background-opacity
key.description: Opacity for the folder popup background color (0.0 = fully transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque).

key.name: folder-popup-border-color
key.description: Border color for the folder popup dialog. Empty uses the theme default.

key.name: folder-popup-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels for the folder popup dialog. 0 uses the theme default.

key.name: folder-tile-background-color
key.description: Background color for the app grid folder tile. Empty uses the theme default.

key.name: folder-tile-background-opacity
key.description: Opacity for the app grid folder tile background color (0.0 = fully transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque).

key.name: folder-tile-border-color
key.description: Border color for the app grid folder tile. Empty uses the theme default.

key.name: folder-tile-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels for the app grid folder tile. 0 uses the theme default.

key.name: folder-side-padding
key.description: Horizontal padding in pixels inside the folder popup. Can be negative for tighter layouts.

key.name: reload-signal
key.description: Internal flag toggled to ask the running extension to reload settings.

key.name: appgrid-background-mode
key.description: Controls the background of the app grid: system default, solid color, or gradient.

key.name: appgrid-background-color
key.description: Hex color used when background mode is solid-color. Empty uses the theme default.

key.name: appgrid-gradient-type
key.description: Gradient type when background mode is gradient: linear-vertical or linear-horizontal.

key.name: appgrid-gradient-secondary-color
key.description: Secondary hex color for gradients. Empty uses an automatically derived color from the primary background color.
